title: Omnisnap host
description: The machine a bundle was captured on (host.json). An output: consumers ignore unknown fields.

fonts.description: Generic font family -> the family it resolved to on this machine.

machine.description: Identifies a machine. Also the per-result host of summary.json, so merge can combine machines.

id.description: A label for the machine, e.g. runner-ubuntu.

version.description: Empty when it could not be read without launching.

profile.description: fresh: new temporary profile; warm: a warmed template (SPEC-branded); neutral: features that block requests turned off.
